this is editorial addition; [agency] "The Lord himself remembered this as spoken about him" vs "τούτου δὲ καὶ αὐτὸς ὁ κύριος ἐμνημόνευσεν ὡς εἰς αὐτὸν εἰρημένου": ὡς εἰς αὐτὸν εἰρημένου means 'as spoken to him,' not 'about him' | part 2/5: [scripture] "Matthew 3:17" vs "Οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ υἱός μου ὁ ἀγαπητὸς εἰς ὃν εὐδόκησα": Source quotes no scripture reference; Matthew 3:17 is editorial addition; [scripture] "Psalm 15 [16]" vs "ἐν πεντεκαιδεκάτῳ": Should be Psalm 15 [16]:11; '15' alone is ambiguous; [completeness] "Psalm 15 [16]" vs "ἐν πεντεκαιδεκάτῳ προείρηται μετὰ τὴν ἀνάστασιν": 'after the resurrection' dropped from scripture context; [agency] "who were made for this purpose" vs "ἐπὶ τούτῳ γεγενημένων": Ambiguous: 'having been generated for this' refers to humans, but 'purpose' overdetermines | part 3/5: [agency] "through God it might seek" vs "ἐπὶ θεοῦ μήσῃ": ἐπὶ θεοῦ means 'on/upon God' not 'through God'; agency misattributed; [modality] "can understand" vs "ἔστι...συνιέναι": ἔστι = 'it is possible' not 'can'; modal nuance softened; [completeness] "For not loving to endure by his own small strength" vs "μὴ τῇ μικρᾷ γὰρ ἰσχύι τῇ ἑαυτοῦ ἀγαπῶν διαρκεῖσθαι": ἀγαπῶν = 'loving' not 'not loving'; negation μὴ goes with διαρκεῖσθαι, not ἀγαπῶν; [negation] "not loving to endure" vs "μὴ...ἀγαπῶν διαρκεῖσθαι": μὴ negates infinitive διαρκεῖσθαι ('to be sustained'), not participle ἀγαπῶν ('loving'); [modality] "he seeks not to be left without true strength" vs "ζητεῖ μὴ τῆς ὄντως ἰσχύος ἀπολείπεσθαι": ζητεῖ μὴ = 'he seeks that...not' or 'he seeks not to be left'; ambiguous but better 'he seeks not to be left behind from true strength'; [agency] "I was brought to tears" vs "εἰς δάκρυα προηγόμην ἐγώ": προηγόμην = 'I was led forth/forward' middle voice, not passive 'was brought'; [completeness] "living with the most unpleasant grief" vs "ἀηδεστάτῃ λύπῃ συνών": συνών = 'being with/together with' not 'living with'; participle of συνεῖμι; [scripture] "Psalm 6:2" vs "Ἐλέησόν με, κύριε, ὅτι ἀσθενής εἰμι": Psalm 6:2 in LXX is Psalm 6:3 in Hebrew; should be Psalm 6[6]:2 or Psalm 6:3 | part 4/5: [scripture] ""Blessed are those who mourn, for they will be comforted" (Matthew 5:4)" vs "Μακάριοι οἱ πενθοῦντες ὅτι αὐτοὶ παρακληθήσονται": No scripture citation in Greek source; Matthew 5:4 is editorial addition; [completeness] "These things are intelligible concerning the future and the promises according to the law" vs "ταῦτα δὴ συνετὰ περὶ τῶν μελλόντων καὶ τῶν κατὰ νόμον ἐπαγγελιῶν": Dropped δὴ ('therefore'/'indeed'), altering logical connection; [source_identity] "[the text is corrupt here]" vs "† προφήτας ὧν": Editorial conjecture presented as bracketed note; source has corrupt † προφήτας ὧν; [agency] "What follows is a narrative of the things that still grieve" vs "τὰ δὲ μετὰ τοῦτο διήγησις τῶν ἔτι λυπούντων": τὰ δὲ μετὰ τοῦτο is 'the things after this', not 'what follows is'; missing ἐστιν understood | part 5/5: [source_identity] "Separation from the one desired melts the soul that desires" vs "κεχωρίσθαι δὲ θεοῦ φησιν": Invented clause not in source; Greek begins with 'to have been separated from God'; [agency] "I am separated from God, he says" vs "κεχωρίσθαι δὲ θεοῦ φησιν": Subject is impersonal/infinitival, not 'I'; no 'I' in source; [completeness] "as long as he does not yet see paradise" vs "ἕως οὔπω παράδεισον ὁρᾷ": ἕως means 'until', not 'as long as'; changes temporal logic; [mistranslation] "his own foundation from the beginning" vs "τὴν ἰδίαν πῆξιν τὴν ἀπ' ἀρχῆς": πῆξις means 'fixing/settling/establishment', not 'foundation'; [mistranslation] "very small compared to that one" vs "μικρότατον ὡς πρὸς ἐκεῖνο": μικρότατον is superlative 'smallest/very small', but 'that one' adds referent not explicit; [completeness] "with calamities rushing upon him one after another like torrents" vs "ταῖς ἐπ' ἀλλήλοις συμφοραῖς κρουνηδὸν ἐπιφερομέναις": ἐπ' ἀλλήλοις means 'upon one another', not 'one after another'; [scripture] "Psalm 89: "Fill us in the morning with your mercy" (Psalm 89:14 [90:14])" vs "ἐν ΠΘ": ΠΘ = 89 in Greek numerals, but LXX Psalm 89:14 = Hebrew/English 90:14; bracketed number correct but citation format confusing; [mistranslation] "the conversation with God through hymns" vs "ἡ δι' ὕμνων ὁμιλία πρὸς θεὸν": Correct; but 'conversation' for ὁμιλία acceptable; [mistranslation] "the stretching out in prayer" vs "ἡ δι' εὐχῶν ἀπότασις": ἀπότασις means 'extension/stretching out', but technical term for prayer posture; acceptable

ADJUDICATED @cf/zai-org/glm-5.2 (Densify (agent), clause-by-clause check against the Greek, 2026-10-09): I found no meaning error.
